title: Machine routing table split ahead of protocol version 2
summary: No change for consumers. The ia CLI's machine routing table now names the nine version-1 operations and, after them, the operations a later protocol version adds, which is empty in this release. Such an operation shares its name with a consumer command and would take the machine route only when --params or --schema is given in an option position. The nine machine routes, their --help and their --schema output are unchanged.
